value_stream.name: Disaster Relief Supply Chain Logistics & Humanitarian Aid Coordination

fields.Owner: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager
fields.Participants: DRRMC Officers, Store Managers, LP team (VS-23)
fields.Trigger: Activation of disaster response plan (VS-69); storm landfall imminent

workflows.name: LGU Disaster Operations Center (DRRMC) Collaboration & Communication

Automation Opportunity: - Shared LGU contact sheet and communication log in cloud portal.
Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Joint plans signed by Regional Manager; LGU authorization badges distributed to store staff.
Cross-references: - links to VS-69 (typhoon response), VS-23 (loss prevention), VS-76 (LGU compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Communication breakdown**: Mobile networks down, losing touch with LGU; mitigated by pre-positioning satellite phones and two-way radios at key regional stores.
System Touchpoints: - LGU directory, emergency comm channel (radio/satellite), LP dashboard (VS-23).

steps.a: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager
steps.activity: Establish contact with the LGU Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (DRRMC) Command Center.
steps.r: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager

steps.a: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager
steps.activity: Provide BuildRight point-of-contact, store emergency numbers, and inventory status list (generators, water, tools).
steps.r: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager

steps.a: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager
steps.activity: Receive road status, utility updates, security briefs, and localized disaster declarations from DRRMC.
steps.r: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager

steps.a: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager
steps.activity: Coordinate joint efforts: arrange for store parking lots to be used as evacuation staging, or set up mobile charging stations.
steps.r: Government Affairs Specialist / Regional Store Operations Manager

fields.Participants: Fleet Drivers, DSWD Warehouse Receiver, Port Liaison Officer
fields.Trigger: DSWD or Red Cross release of emergency PO (W5182)

workflows.name: DSWD (Social Welfare) & Red Cross Priority Relief Delivery Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Automated delivery status update sms/email to DSWD tracking contact.
Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Signed receipts scanned and uploaded to ERP project tracking database; driver logs reconciled.
Cross-references: - links to VS-06 (logistics), VS-56 (3PL), VS-110 (freight procurement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Logistics checkpoint blockade**: LGU checkpoints block trucks due to confusing local rules; mitigated by securing DTI/NDRRMC priority clearance certificates.
System Touchpoints: - Fleet dispatch screen (VS-06), carrier booking portal (VS-56), logistics control tower (W250).

steps.a: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)
steps.activity: Secure emergency dispatch manifest: verify destination DSWD/Red Cross drop-off facility or disaster zone.
steps.r: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)

steps.a: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)
steps.activity: Apply DSWD priority transport banner on delivery trucks to bypass traffic checkpoints and port queues.
steps.r: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)

steps.a: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)
steps.activity: Execute delivery: transport relief kits or building supplies, monitor vehicle GPS, and communicate safety status.
steps.r: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)

steps.a: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)
steps.activity: Obtain DSWD/Red Cross signed Goods Receipt Slip and delivery receipt verification.
steps.r: Logistics Dispatch Supervisor (VS-06) / 3PL Coordinator (VS-56)

fields.Owner: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager
fields.Participants: NGO Partner, Corporate Sponsors, Finance, Logistics
fields.Trigger: NGO request to buy and ship relief materials; CSR foundation planning (VS-152)

workflows.name: NGO & Corporate Foundation Emergency Logistics Sponsorship Matching

Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Sponsorship agreements audited by internal audit; fund matching verified against bank statements.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Donation fund delays**: Waiting for donor wire transfer before booking stock, losing stock to retail sales; mitigated by securing bank guarantee or foundation reserve funds.
System Touchpoints: - CSR donation tracker (VS-152), B2B order entry (VS-11), ERP accounting ledger.

steps.a: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager
steps.activity: Create corporate sponsorship matching program: match donor funds to pre-positioned relief items at discounted rates.
steps.r: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager

steps.a: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager
steps.activity: Coordinate materials booking: earmark stock in ERP for NGO account upon donation fund confirmation.
steps.r: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager

steps.a: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager
steps.activity: Arrange subsidized logistics: split transport costs between BuildRight CSR foundation and the corporate sponsor.
steps.r: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager

steps.a: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager
steps.activity: Compile post-delivery compliance reports (delivery photos, recipient counts) and send to NGO/donor.
steps.r: CSR Foundation Manager (VS-152) / B2B Account Manager

fields.Participants: Store Staff, CSR Foundation team (VS-152), Local Barangay Officials
fields.Trigger: Storm landfall; store declared safe for operations in devastated area

workflows.name: Store-Level Disaster Relief Hub Setup & Community Distribution Point Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile app based recipient registration and signature logging.
Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Signed recipient list verified; generator/fuel usage logs signed by Store Manager and LP Officer.
Cross-references: - links to VS-152 (CSR), VS-159 (corporate security), VS-76 (LGU compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Crowd control / Security risk**: Large crowds rushing the distribution point, causing injury; mitigated by requesting barangay/police security presence (VS-159).
System Touchpoints: - Store operations checklist, CSR foundation tracking (VS-152).

steps.a: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator
steps.activity: Establish the BuildRight Relief Zone in the store parking lot or covered yard.
steps.r: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator

steps.a: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator
steps.activity: Set up charging stations (powered by pre-positioned generators, W5180) for local community mobile phones.
steps.r: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator

steps.a: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator
steps.activity: Provide free drinking water filtration station (powered by store deep well or water tanks).
steps.r: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator

steps.a: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator
steps.activity: Coordinate relief kit distribution with local Barangay officials: verify names against municipal list, issue kits, and log distributions.
steps.r: Store Manager / Regional Operations Coordinator

fields.Participants: Store Manager, Safety Officer (VS-24), LGU Building Official
fields.Trigger: Post-storm damage assessment completion (VS-69); structural damage suspected

workflows.name: Disaster Area Store Reopening Safety Clearance & Structural Integrity Audit

Automation Opportunity: - Digital inspection checklists and photo uploads.
Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Structural safety certificate signed by licensed Civil/Structural Engineer; LGU reopen permit secured.
Cross-references: - links to VS-138 (facilities), VS-24 (HSE), VS-27 (IT), VS-76 (LGU compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Opening unsafe building**: Racking collapse or electrical short injuring staff/customers; mitigated by mandatory structural sign-off prior to employee entry.
System Touchpoints: - Facilities database (VS-138), OSH logs (VS-24), IT service portal (VS-27).

steps.a: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)
steps.activity: Inspect store building envelope: check roof trusses, glass panels, warehouse racking, solar panels, and electrical wiring.
steps.r: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)

steps.a: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)
steps.activity: Verify utility safety: check for water damage in electrical panels, test generator transfer switch, and inspect sewage system.
steps.r: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)

steps.a: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)
steps.activity: Draft structural integrity report; secure safety clearance from LGU Office of Building Official (OBO).
steps.r: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)

steps.a: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)
steps.activity: Re-commission POS registers and network systems (VS-27) before opening doors to retail customers.
steps.r: Facilities Manager (VS-138) / Structural Engineer (Contracted)

fields.Owner: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)
fields.Participants: Store Managers, DC Managers, Fuel Supplier, LP (VS-23)
fields.Trigger: Widespread power grid failure post-disaster; fuel stations offline
fields.Volume: Reconciliation covering affected DCs and store groups

workflows.name: Emergency Fleet Fuel Allocation & Auxiliary Power Logistics

Automation Opportunity: - Automatic generator fuel level sensor warnings to logistics control tower.
Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Bulk fuel deliveries verified by weighbridge / dip-stick; fuel disbursements log signed by LP.
Cross-references: - links to VS-61 (fuel management), VS-06 (logistics), VS-23 (loss prevention), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fuel running out**: Store goes completely offline, losing security system; mitigated by maintaining 72-hour fuel buffer in all store backup generators.
System Touchpoints: - Fleet fuel portal (VS-61), DC operations system (VS-04), LP logs (VS-23).

steps.a: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)
steps.activity: Assess fuel status: audit diesel levels in store/DC backup generators and fleet vehicles.
steps.r: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)

steps.a: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)
steps.activity: Coordinate fuel tankers: purchase priority bulk diesel from partner oil companies (VS-61) and direct deliveries to affected sites.
steps.r: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)

steps.a: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)
steps.activity: Set up emergency fuel allocation rules: prioritize fuel for store generators (to prevent server/security outages) and fleet trucks delivering relief kits.
steps.r: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)

steps.a: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)
steps.activity: Log fuel consumption at stores/DCs; audit fuel transfers to prevent siphoning/theft (VS-23).
steps.r: Fuel & Fleet Cost Manager (VS-61) / Fleet Supervisor (VS-06)

fields.Participants: Drivers, COD Cashier, Loss Prevention (VS-23), HR (VS-103)
fields.Trigger: Outbound relief delivery execution; COD transactions in affected zones

workflows.name: Humanitarian Delivery Cash Reconciliation & Driver Safety Vetting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated cash matching on driver app.
Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: Drivers vetted before dispatch; cash box counts verified by cashier and supervisor.
Cross-references: - links to VS-142 (COD), VS-167 (background screening), VS-23 (loss prevention), VS-103 (HR shared services)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Driver safety risk / Cash theft**: Driver injured or cash stolen on route; mitigated by cash limits on trucks and tracking routes through GPS.
System Touchpoints: - COD portal (VS-142), workforce screening system (VS-167), driver logs.
Time Estimate: - ~30 mins per driver briefing and reconciliation

steps.a: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)
steps.activity: Vet drivers for high-risk disaster routes: verify license status, health clearance, and defensive driving history.
steps.r: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)

steps.a: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)
steps.activity: Issue cash box and mobile POS: instruct drivers on cash handling for COD relief orders (VS-142).
steps.r: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)

steps.a: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)
steps.activity: Brief drivers on safety and route hazards: identify bridge washouts, landslide spots, and looting areas.
steps.r: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)

steps.a: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)
steps.activity: Execute delivery; upon return, reconcile cash collection and mobile POS records; audit discrepancies (VS-23).
steps.r: COD Controller (VS-142) / Workforce Vetting Specialist (VS-167)

fields.Owner: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)
fields.Participants: VP Supply Chain, Store Ops VP, CFO, VP Supply Chain, LP Director
fields.Trigger: De-activation of disaster response plan (typically 30 days post-storm)

workflows.name: Post-Disaster Supply Chain Recovery, Lessons-Learned & BCP Update

Controls: - CTL-772 (ensure controlled execution — Priority Relief Routing, LGU Coordination & Humanitarian Partner Logistics (PA-180.3).)
- CTL-772: BCP updates signed off by Risk Manager and COO; training scheduled for next season.
Cross-references: - links to VS-26 (BCP), VS-21 (internal audit), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Repeating past mistakes**: Supply bottlenecks recurrent in next storm; mitigated by mandatory BCP updates and staging parameter adjustments within 30 days.
System Touchpoints: - BCP document portal (VS-26), Risk dashboard (VS-21), Board portal (VS-36).

steps.a: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)
steps.activity: De-mobilize emergency logistics zones at DCs; return fleet vehicles to standard delivery schedules.
steps.r: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)

steps.a: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)
steps.activity: Conduct post-disaster audit: review margin losses, inventory write-offs, transport delays, and compliance issues.
steps.r: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)

steps.a: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)
steps.activity: Host the Lessons-Learned Workshop: gather feedback from store managers, drivers, and procurement team.
steps.r: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)

steps.a: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)
steps.activity: Update the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and S&OP staging models based on findings; submit updates to Board Risk Committee (VS-36).
steps.r: Director of Business Continuity / Risk Manager (VS-26)
